packs.name: @agileflow/agile
packs.description: AgileFlow Work workflows for epics, stories, and decision records. Installed by `agileflow work init`. No hooks, no agents, no runtime.

packs.name: @agileflow/communication
packs.description: Manually invoked interaction styles (interviews, simpler explanations).

packs.name: @agileflow/core
packs.description: Everyday engineering workflows. Installed by `agileflow init --yes`.

packs.name: @agileflow/github
packs.description: Pull request workflows for GitHub repositories. Requires the GitHub CLI (`gh`), authenticated, with network access.
